ops.title: open-pr plugin + ccx vcs ship fixes (cross-repo)
ops.description:
New `plugins/open-pr` in cc-skills, plus three fixes in cc-context (`/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-context`) that it depends on.

Plan: `/Users/yasyf/.claude/plans/lets-create-a-open-pr-floofy-octopus.md`

**cc-context.** (A) `internal/vcs/github.go` — Repo/Mine/Personal/Writable/LookupRepo with a two-tier 24h cache; `GraphiteRepo` common-dir fix for linked worktrees; `internal/cli/lane.go` `resolveLane` folding the three copy-pasted `gtLane :=` idioms (ship.go:171, restack.go:56, reviews.go:239) behind three gates — `ccx.nogt` config, `!Mine()`, gt reachability — all applied before any mutation. (B) `resolveBranchPlan`/`deriveBranchName` replacing the logic spread across shipgt.go:137/192 and ship.go:545; per-lane branch creation (`gt create --onto`, `jj bookmark create`, `git switch -c`); post-commit HEAD self-heal. (C) `--pr-title`/`--pr-body-file` (repeatable, branch-scoped) and `shipPR` owning PR create/update in every lane, backfilling every bodyless downstack PR. (D) `ccx vcs info` and `ccx vcs guidelines`.

**cc-skills.** `plugins/open-pr` — two skills (`open-pr`, `pr-loop`), two agents (`pr-style-scout`, `pr-watcher`), two scripts (`pr-cache.sh`, `pr-poll.sh`).

Ordering that matters: B before C, because the jj/git lane cannot open a PR until ship can create a branch — there is no PR from `main` into `main`.

ops.text: cc-context: task test and task lint pass, and the 24 pre-existing gt tests keep byte-identical assertInvocations sequences
T1 regression: in a repo with a stale .git/.graphite_repo_config that is not Graphite-synced, ship makes no gt call and forms no commit on a gt branch
T3 regression: in a linked worktree, GraphiteRepo detects the config via the common dir, and after a ship git symbolic-ref HEAD resolves with the branch ref at the tip
T4 regression: on trunk in a non-personal repo, a no-flag ship creates a branch before committing
T5 regression: on a non-trunk bookmark, a no-flag ship appends to it and names it in the report, with no refusal
Personal-repo carve-out: on a repo whose owner is the viewer, a no-flag ship on trunk still pushes trunk
ccx vcs ship opens a PR with a non-empty body in the jj/git lane and sets bodies on every bodyless PR in a gt submit
/open-pr runs end to end on an owned repo: reports the lane, writes a guidelines card, scouts style once and reuses the cache, ships a created branch, opens a PR, hands off a named background watcher
